branch_policy: Original axis -> arm-* -> twig hierarchy; primary arms/trunks base 0.63, subordinate twigs/foliage base 0.45
context_policy: bounded +/-0.13; positively correlated width/context oscillation reduced up to 50%; family ranges applied
estimated_fields: D mountain neighborhoods and valley semantics remain estimates, not original mass/valley IDs.
historical_675: recomputed, never authoritative; canonical historical records remain exact
ordering: Baseline sequence and vertex direction locked; no reversal or reordering
saturation_is_not_failure: Bounds are provisional artistic limits. Every clip, flat profile and rapid transition is reported, not silently corrected.
width_policy: 0.085*log2(width/stroke median) bounded to +/-0.15, 1.2 mm arclength smoothing; never minmax 0-1
